description_short: Cross-table aggregation of synthesis temperature (Table 3) and device performance (Table 5) for rare-earth oxide matrices that appear in both the ALD process overview and the Er3+-based MOSLED performance comparison.

paper.title: Atomic and Molecular Layer Deposition of Functional Thin Films Based on Rare Earth Elements

tables_modeled.label: Table 3
tables_modeled.description: Rare-earth ALD process overview: materials, metal precursors, co-reactants, GPC values, and deposition temperatures.

tables_modeled.label: Table 5
tables_modeled.description: Performance characteristics of Er3+-based MOSLED devices: host matrices, annealing temperatures, EQE, power efficiency, threshold voltage, emission lifetime (τ), and operational lifetime (OLT).

join_strategy.description: Aligns host matrices from the MOSLED performance table (Table 5) with ALD process materials from the process overview (Table 3) using normalized labels and fuzzy string matching.
steps: From Table 5 comparison R1469991, retrieve host matrices via P180031 and their labels (?hostLabel).
From Table 3 comparison R1471077, retrieve materials via P9071 and their labels (?mat3Label).
Normalize each label by lowercasing and stripping parenthetical content (e.g., dopant annotations) using regex into ?h_norm and ?m3_norm.
Use FILTER(CONTAINS(?h_norm, ?m3_norm) || CONTAINS(?m3_norm, ?h_norm)) to allow partial matches in both directions.
Bind a human-readable matrix label via COALESCE(?hostLabel, ?mat3Label, STR(?host)).
join_strategy.limitations: The fuzzy CONTAINS-based join is heuristic and may include ambiguous matches if two materials have very similar names, or miss matches when naming diverges strongly (different abbreviations or translations).

aggregation_logic.description: The query aggregates multiple records per matrix to obtain representative synthesis and performance values.
details: Synthesis temperature (synthesis_temp) is taken as MAX(?synT) over all joined process rows in Table 3, after filtering for physically plausible values (50–1500 °C).
Annealing temperature (annealing_temp) is taken as MAX(?annT) from P180032 in Table 5.
EQE, power efficiency, and emission lifetime are each summarized as MAX of their numeric values, reflecting best reported performance per matrix in the review.
Numeric values are extracted from mixed-format literals using regex to capture the first number (e.g., '36', '≈15', '24 (peak)').

output_shape.description: Each output row corresponds to one rare-earth oxide matrix that has both ALD process information (Table 3) and MOSLED performance data (Table 5).
columns: matrix: normalized host/matrix label shared between Tables 3 and 5.
synthesis_temp: representative ALD deposition temperature (°C) extracted from Table 3 (P180013).
annealing_temp: representative post-deposition annealing temperature (°C) from Table 5 (P180032).
eqe: maximum external quantum efficiency (%) from Table 5 (P180033).
power_eff: maximum reported power efficiency (×10⁻⁴) from Table 5 (P180034).
lifetime: maximum reported emission lifetime τ (ms) from Table 5 (P180036).

postprocessing_notes.interpretation: This query operationalizes the question 'How do synthesis (ALD deposition) and post-processing (annealing) conditions relate to optical performance for rare-earth oxide MOSLED hosts that appear in both the process and device tables?' It connects ALD thermal budgets to EQE, power efficiency, and emission lifetime, enabling matrix-level comparisons that would otherwise require manual cross-reading of Tables 3 and 5 in the original Ghazy et al. review.
